email.subject: Quick fix for Northwind Plumbing's site
email.body:
Jack,

Noticed your site lists your number as plain text, not a tap-to-call link. Most people searching for a plumber do it from their phone, often during an emergency — if they can't tap to call, they move to the next result.

Your site also doesn't list hours, so visitors can't tell if you're open now, which matters most for urgent calls.

I fix these kinds of issues for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's costing you calls?

Alex
